open_points.subject: Model M11 — OwnerSession expiry
open_points.text: written once: the instant it began, its expiry at the latest
open_points.question: Is this fact a fixed absolute latest-expiry instant, a current expiry instant that requests may move, or both as separate facts?
options: One fixed absolute latest-expiry instant
One current expiry instant that may change
Separate absolute and current expiry instants

open_points.subject: Model M11 — OwnerSession CSRF value
open_points.question: Who creates the CSRF value, and as part of which product action does it enter the OwnerSession?
options: Registry mints it when sign-in creates the session
Registry mints it through a later session action
The owner interface supplies it
open_points.default_guess: Registry mints it when sign-in creates the session

open_points.subject: Model M11 — last-request instant
open_points.text: changed by the owner's requests: the instant of its last request
open_points.question: Which owner-interface actions or requests move the last-request instant?
options: Every authenticated owner request, including reads
Only owner actions that change Registry state
Only requests relevant to session lifetime
open_points.default_guess: Every authenticated owner request, including reads

open_points.subject: Model M11 — pending confirmations
open_points.question: Does an OwnerSession hold one replaceable pending confirmation for the whole session, one per confirmable action kind, or several concurrent pending confirmations?
options: One pending confirmation for the whole session
At most one pending confirmation per action kind
Several concurrent pending confirmations
open_points.default_guess: One pending confirmation for the whole session

open_points.subject: Model M11 — confirmation lifecycle
open_points.text: its pending confirmation values ... each kept until used, replaced or the session ends ... The confirmation id of an action the owner confirms in it is minted per confirmation, not per session
open_points.question: Is the confirmation id itself one of the pending values created before confirmation, or is it minted only when the pending confirmation is used successfully?
options: The id is minted with the pending confirmation
The id is minted only when confirmation succeeds
Pending and completed confirmations have separate identifiers
open_points.default_guess: The id is minted only when confirmation succeeds

open_points.subject: Model M11 — uploaded import file
open_points.text: the import file uploaded in it, each kept until used, replaced or the session ends
open_points.question: Which product action creates or replaces this session fact, and which action reads and consumes it?
options: A distinct upload action stores or replaces it, and confirmed import consumes it
The import action uploads it and a later confirmation consumes it
Each confirmed import request carries and consumes the file without a separate upload action
open_points.default_guess: A distinct upload action stores or replaces it, and confirmed import consumes it

open_points.subject: Model M11 — transient fact lifecycle
open_points.text: the instant of its last request, its pending confirmation values and the import file uploaded in it, each kept until used, replaced or the session ends
open_points.question: Does “used” clear all three listed facts, or only pending confirmation values and the uploaded import file?
options: Only pending confirmation values and the import file are cleared when used
All three facts may be cleared when used
Each fact has a separately specified clearing rule
open_points.default_guess: Only pending confirmation values and the import file are cleared when used

open_points.subject: Model M11 — uploaded import file disclosure
open_points.text: the import file uploaded in it ... | `business_confidential` | every other fact of every model: ... the owner session |
open_points.question: Is the uploaded import file a `personal_data` OwnerSession fact because it contains imported customer and object values, or does the statement that every OwnerSession fact is `business_confidential` still apply to it?
options: The uploaded file is `personal_data`
The uploaded file is `business_confidential`
The file is not a model fact and must be excluded from the OwnerSession facts
